rationale: verify_epic_branch_before_merge() already builds child env additively (os.environ.copy() + overlay); no codebase precedent excludes an inherited env var for isolation, and LL_VERIFY_GATE's only consumer is a test self-quarantine flag, not a side-effect suppressor. Sharing fixes the same data-loss failure mode for verify-gate's test_run_events rows that BUG-3112 fixes for sessions.
rule: Verify-gate worktree: share LL_HISTORY_DB, no special case (Option A)
alternatives_rejected: Option B: keep verify-gate isolated from shared history DB (do not set LL_HISTORY_DB when LL_VERIFY_GATE=1) — scored 6/12 vs Option A's 10/12; would be a first-of-its-kind conditional exclusion with no precedent.
